source_row.rationale: Hydromorphone is significantly more potent than morphine on a milligram-for-milligram basis (opioid conversion references vary but hydromorphone is commonly considered several times more potent than oral morphine). Careful, accurate dose calculation using appropriate equianalgesic conversion tools is essential when switching between these medications to avoid a dangerous overdose.
source_row.source_detail: Dosage/conversion guidance: hydromorphone is a potent opioid and conversion from other opioids requires conservative individualized dosing; DailyMed current labeling search, accessed 2026-08-14.
